## 📋 Pull Request Description
*Provide a concise summary of the changes made, the problem solved, and any background context.*

## 🔧 Type of Change
*Select the option that applies:*
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Code Refactoring / Styling (no structural or API changes)
- [ ] Documentation update

## 🧪 Testing and Verification
*Explain how the changes were verified:*
1. **Automated Tests:** *Did you write or run unit/integration tests? List the commands.*
2. **Manual Verification:** *How did you test this manually? (e.g. verified responsive cards on mobile Chrome at 375px wide, verified login credentials admin/adminpassword).*

## 📸 Screenshots or Recordings (If applicable)
*Attach screenshots or videos demonstrating visual layout or feature behavior.*

## 📝 Pull Request Checklist
*Ensure all boxes are checked before submitting the PR:*
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] My changes generate no new compile warnings or errors.
- [ ] I have added/updated Flyway migration files if database schema was altered.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (`README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`) if necessary.
- [ ] My commits follow the Conventional Commits specifications.
